name: sdlc-harness
description: Agentic SDLC harness — principled, evidence-backed, cross-model-reviewed software delivery for any Claude Code project. Five-agent shape (planner/builder/reviewer/security/release), seventeen slash commands (/feature-init, /feature-loop, /feature-orchestrate, /feature-review, /feature-reflect, ...), supervisor capsules + continuous self-improvement loop, pure-bash deterministic scripts, optional Codex-CLI cross-model review.
